messages:
Ravi N.: heads-up: v4.0-int4 shadow showed odd rerank inversions on outbound-sales slice this morning.
Priya S.: numbers?
Ravi N.: precision@5 down 5.1 points on that slice; conversely generic chat slices look fine. Token-level alignment score drops mostly for prompts with long enumerations.
Liam G.: our canary gating config: critical_slice_drop_threshold=3.0 (precision@k), rerank_inversion_rate=1.5% -> soft-fallback. Hard rollback if (precision_drop>5 AND latency_p95>+30ms) over 15m.
Ravi N.: interestingly, int4 with asymmetric quant matrix reduces inversion rate by half in local runs. Suspect calibration bins for rare tokens in enumerations.
ops-bot: queued AB job: id=1726009999-ab, targets=4000, slices=[outbound-sales,customer-support], stratify=enumeration-heavy
Priya S.: proposal: block wide promotion. Run 4k A/B with variants: A=nl4-int4-standard, B=nl4-int4-asymm-calib. Collect sample diffs and set auto-fallback if precision@5 delta <= -3.0 OR inversion_rate > 1.5% for 2 consecutive 10m windows.
Ravi N.: I'll add a token-coverage metric to the run and enable sample logging for any inverted-rank cases. Also attach model metadata: model_tag=rwd-v4.0, quant=n4-int4-asym, build=9c4d2b.
eval-bot: AB run started, will push interim every 10m to https://dash.internal/runs/1726009999-ab
Liam G.: add hysteresis: require condition to persist across two windows to avoid flapping. If we hit soft-fallback, flip 20% traffic to fp16-stable for 20m and notify owners. If both precision drop and latency spike, execute hard rollback.
telemetry: acknowledged. Interim 10m aggregates scheduled.
Ravi N.: quick sanity snippet I used locally:
````
# pseudo
variants=["std-int4","asym-int4"]
res=run_ab(variants,n=4000,stratify="enum_heavy")
if res.precision5.delta <= -0.03 or res.inversion_rate>0.015:
    trigger_soft_fallback()
elif res.precision5.delta <= -0.05 and res.latency.p95_delta>30:
    trigger_hard_rollback()
else:
    allow_promote()
````
Priya S.: thanks. Liam, Ben in infra should be on standby for fast flip automation. I'll keep this thread updated as eval-bot posts results.
eval-bot: interim agg (10m): outbound-sales precision@5 delta = -2.8, inversion_rate=1.2%
Ravi N.: that's borderline. Keep running.
telemetry: final agg (run complete): outbound-sales precision@5 delta = -3.6, inversion_rate=1.9, customer-support delta = -0.4
Liam G.: final verdict: outbound-sales crosses soft-fallback threshold -> ops-bot please execute soft-fallback and pin the rollout.
ops-bot: executing soft-fallback: routing 20% traffic to rwd-v4.0-fp16-stable, watch=20m, owners_notified=["Ravi N.","Priya S."]
Ravi N.: captured failing pairs and uploaded to the run artifacts. Starting token-coverage triage.
Priya S.: we'll resume after triage with asym-calib candidate if it passes extended slice checks. Thanks all.
